Legaliam – AI-Powered Legal Information Assistant
Legaliam is an AI-powered legal information assistant designed to help you better
understand legal topics, review documents, generate AI-created document drafts, and make
legal information more accessible. Whether you’re learning about contracts, consumer
rights, workplace issues, or preparing a document draft, Legaliam helps you navigate legal
information in a clear and convenient way.
What You Can Do with Legaliam
Learn About Legal Topics
Receive AI-generated general legal information and explanations about topics such as
contracts, consumer rights, landlord-tenant issues, employment, property, business
agreements, and more.
Generate AI-Created Document Drafts
Create customizable draft documents, including agreements, demand letters, notices,
complaints, affidavits, NDAs, service contracts, and other commonly used legal templates
based on the information you provide.
Review and Understand Documents
Upload documents to receive AI-generated summaries, explanations, and plain-language
descriptions to help you better understand their contents.
Understand Complex Legal Concepts
Legaliam explains legal terminology and concepts in straightforward language, making legal
information easier to understand.
Access Legal Information Anytime
Get instant access to AI-generated legal information whenever you need it, directly from your
mobile device.
Find Independent Attorneys
Browse a directory of independent licensed attorneys and choose whether to contact an
attorney directly for legal advice or representation.
Ideal For
• Individuals seeking general legal information
• Small business owners
• Freelancers and entrepreneurs
• Students
• Anyone who wants to better understand legal documents or prepare AI-generated
document drafts
Important Disclaimer
Legaliam is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice, legal representation, or create
an attorney-client relationship. The information and document drafts generated by Legaliam
are produced using artificial intelligence for general informational purposes only and should
not be relied upon as a substitute for advice from a licensed attorney. Laws vary by
jurisdiction. If you need legal advice, legal representation, or assistance with a specific legal
matter, consult a licensed attorney. Any attorneys listed in Legaliam are independent
professionals, and users independently choose whether to contact them

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Apodex is AI for Discovery: a self-evolving deep-research AI built to take on the hard questions and show its work. Ask one, and Apodex reads across dozens of sources, reasons over hundreds of steps, and delivers an answer where every key claim traces back to its evidence.

The difference is verification. Most AI grades its own homework, and confidently makes things up when it can't tell the difference. Apodex doesn't. A separate team of AI agents fact-checks each claim, resolves conflicts between sources, and audits the full draft before you ever see it. The agents that check the work never did the work, so they catch the mistakes the original reasoning couldn't see in itself.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

1. Run deep research on demand: market and competitive analysis, scientific literature, due diligence, technical questions that would take an analyst hours.
2. Get sourced answers. Every important claim links to its evidence, so you verify in seconds instead of trusting blindly.
3. Tackle genuinely hard problems, the kind of multi-step research that overwhelms ordinary AI tools and stalls halfway through.

WHY APODEX IS DIFFERENT

1. Built for the hardest problems. Instead of one AI grinding through a long task alone, Apodex puts many specialist agents to work in parallel, so a harder question gets a bigger team, not just a longer wait.
2. Self-evolving. Apodex improves its own answers as it works, drafting, critiquing, and rewriting until the result holds up, with no answer key to lean on.
3. Verified, not just plausible. Apodex is built to catch the most dangerous kind of AI error: the answer that looks right, passes every surface check, and is still wrong.
4. Proven on the benchmarks. Apodex leads or matches the best systems across every major deep-research benchmark, with a decisive lead on science and research tasks.

WHY WE BUILT IT

We believe the most valuable AI won't be the one that chats or generates best, but the one that can discover what no one has found yet, in science, in medicine, in the problems that have no answer key. But you can't discover what you can't verify. So we started with verification. The research tool in your hands today is the first step toward an AI built to find answers no one has written down yet.

BUILT FOR

Scientists, engineers, researchers, analysts, founders, students, and anyone who needs answers they can stand behind, not just a confident-sounding paragraph.
Stop guessing whether your AI got it right. Start with research you can verify.
